newsitem.title: USA: AK Steel elects Wardrop chairman.
newsitem.headline: AK Steel elects Wardrop chairman.

text.p: AK Steel Holding Corp said Monday its board of directors had elected Richard Wardrop Jr. as chairman, to succeed Thomas Graham Sr., who retires Jan 31.

The company said Wardrop, 51, will remain president and chief executive officer, in charge of 5,800 employees in Middletown and Ashland, Ky., that produce low-carbon flat-rolled steel for automotive and other markets.

"AK Steel is in the hands of one of the most talented and effective individuals in the industry," Graham said in a prepared release. "The board has the utmost confidence in Dick Wardrop's leadership as AK Steel embarks upon a tremendous phase of growth."
Wardrop joined the company in 1992 as vice president of manufacturing, was elected president in 1994 and became chief executive officer in May 1995, the company said.
